query: Automotive PCB assemblies Mexico USMCA eligibility

statements.text: A Mexican-assembled ECU populated with ICs fabricated and packaged in Taiwan, capacitors manufactured in Japan, and PCBs fabricated in China contains very little North American-origin material by value.
For most automotive electronics assemblies, the applicable RVC threshold is 75% under the net cost method.
The silicon, passives, and substrates - typically 60% to 80% of material cost in a dense electronics assembly - are not.
For example, if you build the circuit boards in Asia but do the final assembly and testing in Mexico, the product might qualify.
